meta.intendedUse: Culture Szn website master artist profile (authoritative JSON source-of-truth)

sourcePriority: Qobuz (track/album pages with durations + role-tagged credits)
dataIntegrityRules: No biography fields are inferred without an accessible authoritative statement.
Credits-derived identity signals are labeled as such (not treated as biography fact unless explicitly stated by an official bio).
Songs are de-duplicated by canonical title; releaseInstances track re-releases, album inclusion, and early uploads.
If a field is missing, it is stored as null with an explicit status note.
knownLimitations: Verified DOB/POB and early-life narrative not found in accessible sources used.
Awards, nominations, chart performance, and verified live-performance history not found in accessible sources used.
Not every track has full cross-DSP links retrievable; Qobuz links are the most complete in the source set.
